behavior: Every Forwend email looks like a real product's email: one designed HTML layout that renders the same in Gmail, Apple Mail and Outlook, with the plain text kept as the text part
acceptance: Paid, settled, held, the payer receipt and the welcome email are sent with an HTML part and the current plain text as the text part, both carrying the same links

Layout as production transactional email: hidden preheader text; header with the hosted Forwend logo (alt text); a clear title and the amount large; a details table (invoice number, network, token, transaction link where there is one); one bulletproof button (table-based, works without images); footer with why the email was sent, a link to email settings for owner emails, a support contact, and the sender's name and postal address placeholder for Q-13

Built for email clients: 600 px max table layout, inline styles only, web-safe font stack, no scripts, no tracking pixels, no remote assets but the logo; color-scheme meta so dark mode stays readable; contrast meets WCAG AA

Screenshots of each email at 600 px and 375 px, light and dark, are attached to the run; backend tests fail if any email kind lacks an HTML part, if the HTML and text parts link to different pages, or if user-given text (names) is not HTML-escaped
notes: 2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Pass. Ran: go test ./internal/... all ok; e2e gate (-tags e2e ./e2e/) ok 14.4s; pnpm -s lint clean. Logo /icon-192.png served 200 image/png by the dev server. Contrast AA: lowest light pair 5.39 (success badge), lowest dark 8.26; button 15.75. Idempotency key format unchanged; render errors returned before Send and roll back the claim. Escaping: html/template; all hrefs come from PUBLIC_WEB_URL, DB ids/tx hashes or constants; mutation making Value or Lead template.HTML fails TestEmailEscapesTypedNames. Mutations caught: empty HTML, text button URL changed, tx href missing in text, settings link missing in HTML, button href missing. Not caught: (1) email.go:39-41 Resend dropping the html field passes all tests (email_test sends no HTML); fix: set HTML in email_test and assert the body has it. (2) layout.html.tmpl:52 lead paragraph has no word-break: a 60-char name with no spaces (e.g. a typed name that is an email address) makes the 375px email 540px wide (measured with Playwright); details cell wraps fine; fix: add overflow-wrap:anywhere to the lead p and note td. (3) Outlook desktop not verified: button padding is on the <a> (Word ignores it, tight button) and the 600 table uses style width:100% with no MSO ghost table, so it stretches on wide windows; fix: padding on the td, an [if mso] 600px wrapper. (4) With <style> stripped (some Gmail cases) the 32px title breaks at 375 as 'Receipt for INV-' / '0001'. Text part wording changed slightly (View invoice, Email settings, Download receipt (PDF), added details and footer lines); old assertions otherwise unchanged.

2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Re-review of 91e0fe3: all four findings fixed. (1) email_test sends HTML and asserts got[html]. (2) overflow-wrap:anywhere + word-break on h1, lead and note; Playwright scrollWidth at 375px is 375 for all 6 samples, with and without the <style> block, including the 58-char unspaced name (receipt-typed-375-light.png checked). (3) button padding on the td; 600px [if mso] wrapper table. (4) keep() runs template.HTMLEscapeString before wrapping INV-\d+ in a nowrap span; the inserted markup holds only the matched digits, and TestEmailEscapesTypedNames still covers names in the lead. Ran: go test ./internal/notify ./internal/email ok; pnpm -s lint clean. Note: TestEveryEmailHasHTMLWithTheTextLinks now checks the button label instead of the title text (the title now holds a span); fine, not required by the acceptance rows.

proof.3: backend: 600 px table layout with an Outlook-only fixed-width wrapper, inline styles plus a dark-mode block and color-scheme meta, web-safe font stacks, long words wrap and invoice numbers stay whole, no scripts, pixels or remote assets but the logo; every color pair 5.39:1 or more (WCAG AA)
proof.4: backend: docs/runs/F200-emails has 24 screenshots (6 emails x 600/375 x light/dark), none wider than its screen with a 58-character unspaced name; TestEmailEscapesTypedNames fails with text/template
